description: 30-question deterministic eval set for quantization quality benchmark. Each item has accepted reference forms; a response passes if any reference form appears in the (whitespace-normalized) response.

items.prompt: Calculate 7 * 8 * 9. Reply with only the number.
Solve for x: x / 3 + 5 = 11. Reply with only the number.
What is 15% of 240? Reply with only the number.
What is 2^10 - 2? Reply with only the number.
What is the greatest common divisor of 48 and 36? Only the number.
What is 12! (12 factorial) modulo 1000? Reply with only the number.
What is 3/4 + 5/6 as a reduced fraction? Reply like a/b.
A circle has radius 5. Using pi = 3.14, what is its area? Only the number.
What is the exact output of this Python code: print(2**10)? Reply with only the output.
What is the exact output of: print(len('hello world'))? Reply with only the output.
What is the exact output of: print(max([3, 1, 4, 1, 5]))? Reply with only the output.
What is the exact output of: print(7 % 3)? Reply with only the output.
What is the exact output of: print('abc'.upper())? Reply with only the output.
What is the exact output of: print(10 // 3)? Reply with only the output.
What is the exact output of: print(int(3.7))? Reply with only the output.
What is the exact output of: print(list(range(2, 10, 3)))? Reply with only the output.
How many times does the letter 'a' appear in the word 'banana'? Reply with only the number.
How many times does the letter 'l' appear in the word 'lollipop'? Reply with only the number.
How many vowels (a,e,i,o,u) are in the word 'community'? Reply with only the number.
How many times does the letter 's' appear in the word 'mississippi'? Reply with only the number.
How many integers from 1 to 100 (inclusive) are divisible by 7? Reply with only the number.
What is the next number in the sequence: 2, 6, 18, 54? Reply with only the number.
All Bloops are Razy. No Razy is a Bif. Which of these must be true? (A) Some Bif are Bloops (B) No Bloop is a Bif (C) Some Bloops are Bifs. Reply with only the letter.
It takes 5 machines 5 minutes to make 5 widgets. How many minutes does it take 100 machines to make 100 widgets? Reply with only the number.
What is the capital city of France? Reply with only the city name.
What is the chemical formula of water? Reply with only the formula.
How many legs does an adult spider have? Reply with only the number.
Who is the author of the novel 'Dream of the Red Chamber' (紅樓夢)? Reply with only the name.
In the 7-layer OSI model, what is the lowest layer (layer 1) called? Reply with only the layer name.
How many kilobytes are in one gigabyte, using 1024 as the base (1 GiB)? Reply with only the number.
